test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which letter cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

RJXU, ZANB, ?, PITP, XZJW
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c297d1592b96865d3cb0e586a1def73d821af9fc6e5c00d1b0635bc23a38bcde.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37b3c868945e9e3715b7d1807f56fc7cad694651a5cbc543538a3f874b77be7c.png] 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

Each consecutive first letter is 8 letters ahead of the previous cluster's first letter.

Each consecutive last letter is 7 letters ahead of the previous cluster's last letter.

Third letter of the second cluster is 4 letters ahead of the previous cluster's second letter, and this number is decreasing consecutively. 

Second letter of the second cluster is 3 letters ahead of the previous cluster's third letter, and this number is consecutively increasing. 

Therefore, the** missing cluster** in the series is** HRDI.**

The complete series which is observed is RJXU, ZANB, HRDI, PITP, XZJW.

Hence, the correct answer is **"HRDI"**.
